utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look after lunch. Bring the receipt if you have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll bring it by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be here after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we need to keep an eye on timing and supplies if this repair drive is going to work.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm the timing and supplies are actually covered before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Then let’s confirm the timing and supplies are covered before we start, so we don’t get stuck halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, so what changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We pushed the latest repair drive update to tomorrow afternoon, and I think the signup list got moved too. Sorry, I’m a bit fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep reminding folks about the repair drive. I'll tell Ira we should check in on it soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, let's check in soon. I can help keep folks posted when I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll keep reminding folks too, and I’ll check in with you soon about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty well — we’ve got a few fixes done, and I’m just waiting on one more set of hands for the bigger jobs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear. I can help with the bigger jobs when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's keep it simple: I'll check the drive at the usual time and we'll see what needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Eli. I’ll let a few neighbors know so we can be ready when you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’ll take a careful look at the usual time, and then we can decide what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s left to fix on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the small stuff now — a loose hinge, a leaky faucet, and one broken outlet. We should be able to knock out the rest this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll swing by this afternoon and help get those three wrapped up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive's coming together nicely. Want me to connect you with the folks handling donations and the tools?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can put you in touch with both groups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Rosa. I’ll stop by and do my part for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara. I appreciate you stepping up, and I’ll note you for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Rosa. I’ll be there and I’ll do my part for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a bit of extra tarp and two extension cords if the repair drive still needs them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I can bring those over if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s still going strong over on Maple. Folks are dropping off tools and snacks, so if you need anything fixed, now’s the time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I might stop by if I need a wrench or two looked at.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, swing by anytime this afternoon. I saw a couple wrenches on the table, and they’re still handing out lemonade by the shed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What time is the repair drive starting, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 3:30 after school, and I could use help carrying the tools and any extra extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll bring the tools and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What do I need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve got a list in mind. Just bring the tools and a flashlight, and I’ll point you to the house.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll bring the tools and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring that up with Jules and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Vik. Keep me posted and I’ll help line up whoever still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, I’ll keep you posted and line up whoever still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I saw something about that, but I may have missed the change. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use a hand with the repair drive details, just the latest change and where to send people.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing, just send me the latest change and I’ll point people to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can lend a hand if you need it. Just point me to the part that’s giving you trouble.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey. Start with the bracket on the left side of the frame; that’s where the wobble’s coming from.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I’ll take a closer look at that left bracket now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Opal. Tell me which house or fix you want me to start with.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the house on Maple, the one with the porch light that’s been flickering. After that, I’d say check the back gate at the corner place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, I’ll start with the Maple house and then check the back gate at the corner place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the schedule and whether we’ve got enough people to handle the repair drive. Can we confirm the timing and pickup plan first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, let’s lock down the timing and pickup details first so we can see if the schedule really works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is confirmed, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but I want to confirm the details before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s not confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear schedule first. Tell me when the repair drive starts and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure yet, but I can check and get you the start time soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps, but I still need the start time and maybe the day so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m getting that second-hand so I might be a little behind. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it’s happening this week at the community hall. I can check what supplies they still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. Let me know what supplies they still need and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring the ladder over earlier, but I forgot; I can still help now if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can go get it and help where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help coordinate around the school schedule. What time does Leo need me there?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I need you there at 3:30, right after school lets out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me. I’ll be there right after school lets out.
